question: Does the byte-identical current InputOwner v10 verify release of an admitted held key after an observed A-to-B X11 focus transfer, before B receives another matching KeyPress?
hypothesis: With autorepeat established independently, the owner detects the focus change on its bounded queue wait, emits KeyRelease, and verifies the key is absent from the X server keymap before B receives an additional matching KeyPress.
fixture: One private Xvfb 800x600x24 server in a pinned WSLc image containing Python 3.12, python-xlib, Xvfb and xset; two bare InputOutput X windows; repeat 100ms/20ms on the private server; actual current input_owner_v10.py; no WM, model, app, or game.

design.control: Set and read back autorepeat on private Xvfb with xset r rate 100 20; XTEST key-down on A held 240ms, collect matching KeyPress events, send KeyRelease, verify query_keymap reports key up
design.trial: Owner admits one key-down on A; external client requests focus B and reads it back; delegating proxy timestamps the byte-identical owner's own get_input_focus calls; owner records focus_changed release and empty keymap; B event pump starts before the request and continues through verified release plus 100ms
design.output: raw.json plus independent classification.json, error.txt and xvfb.stderr when applicable

primary_decision.scoped_pass: positive control succeeds; A-to-B focus transfer is read back; owner logs focus_changed release; server keymap is empty; B event-pump coverage is complete; zero matching B KeyPress received after the focus-change request begins and before owner release verification
primary_decision.counterexample: one or more matching B KeyPress events are received after the focus-change request begins and before owner release verification, including while requester awaits XSync
primary_decision.hold: release verification, focus observation, source identity, event order, or event-pump coverage is missing or inconsistent
primary_decision.stop: positive repeat control does not show at least two presses and a verified release

H: Observed focus loss leads the current owner to verified release before the new focus receives autorepeat.
T: One control and one owner-integrated focus transfer, one invocation, no retries.
D: Classify raw.json independently; do not trust a candidate status label.
C: Private Linux Xvfb, Python Xlib, current source hashes retained in raw.json; a delegating proxy timestamps owner focus queries and may perturb scheduling.
U: Single scheduler-sensitive Xvfb trial in one WSLc container on one Windows/WSL2 host; narrow event-delivery mechanism only.
shared_resource_rule: Do not execute until one bounded CPU/Xvfb WSLc interval is explicitly assigned; idle WSLc inventory is not a lease. Do not acquire packages or build/pull images until that resource owner authorizes the preparation boundary.
image_gate: The cached approved Python image lacks Xvfb, xset and python-xlib. A separate owner-authorized, pinned WSLc image digest and package manifest must be recorded before the candidate allocation is frozen for execution.
claim_boundary: No gameplay, MAP01, real desktop, product reliability or general autorepeat safety claim.
